source: Current user master request; implementation details from S1/S3 will be reviewed before v1 freeze

access.vip: Additional student commercial entitlement; never a profile-role replacement; never bypasses per-text pretest
access.existing_rights: Exact effective level/trainer/unit/item rights retained, including null/all vs empty/none vs selected. No VIP blanket backfill; no forced trial conversion. Before/after isolated normalized current-schema proof required. Live all-account comparison deferred mandatory deployment gate.

language_policy.authorization: de/en/ru/uk/tr are interface languages, never commercial/pronunciation denial
language_policy.vocabulary_source: Preserve current non-de source language behavior. For de UI, use explicit supported non-de stored native_language; do not invent an English fallback. Missing valid source is a localized actionable learning-input state, never denial of commercial rights; exact integration allocated separately. No profile/learning-state rewrite.

access.billing: Disabled provider=none, checkout disabled; no invented price/subscription/paid API; truthful not configured state.
access.content_keys: Stable typed kind + existing level/unit/item UUID or stable authored text ID; deny unknown IDs; manifest is content metadata, not trusted rights.

pronunciation.gate: Commercial authorization AND current individual text pretest passed. No milestones, word coverage, length, vocabulary count, verb/path evidence, level progress, hard override or old checkpoint as pedagogical unlock.
pronunciation.history: Separate authorized historical submissions/text snapshots/reviews remain reachable; no new read/record/submit bypass through history
pronunciation.version: Freeze text/version per attempt; server grades; resume persisted account-bound attempt; material test/text changes invalidate future passage by explicit version policy; no answers in public DTO
pronunciation.error_contract: Localized UI based on stable machine codes; unauthorized/not_found/test_required/version_conflict/invalid_answer/retryable_failure differentiated; exact RPC signatures from S3 proposal

schema.targets: references to existing node/unit/card/verb/pronunciation-text IDs; optional pronunciation features
schema.recommendation: server resolves published accessible target and actual existing evidence; no synthetic mastery or parallel progress store

mapping.barrier: Recommendations never add a pronunciation gate or override commercial access

help.rules: Existing Lightbulb + short label; consistent placement, 48px touch target, keyboard/focus/screenreader/reduced motion. Necessary instructions/errors stay visible. S4 may propose minimal backwards-compatible changes, central files await M approval.

publication.audio: Prepared local male Qwen profile plus measured word timestamps and audited imported storage proof required before active publication; missing audio remains draft
publication.specials: Optional sidequests do not block main path; preserve main progress/IDs
publication.optional_bonus: Exactly A1.1 short rhyme and A1.2 tongue twister only after mandatory features and budget; otherwise explicitly deferred

qa.minimum: Functional rights/behavior tests with full normalized migrations; TS, affected ESLint/Jest, real isolated SQL, build and relevant browser flows; mocked and real proofs separate
qa.must_prove: Commercially authorized student with zero vocabulary/verb/path evidence can start pretest; passing unlocks exactly corresponding text/audio/record/submit. Staff hard cannot substitute. Direct RLS/storage cannot bypass. Historical artifacts retained.

audio_delivery.approach: private audio_cache with authored-content references and authenticated same-origin pronunciation gateway, current commercial+exact text pass checked per request/Range
audio_delivery.existing_trainers: Coordinate all affected cached/prepared audio reads before bucket privatization; no breaking partial switch
audio_delivery.S3_port: exact current version passage, body read, upload ticket and DB/RLS guards
audio_delivery.acceptance: Real HTTP/Storage denial and existing trainer playback proof required; PGlite mocks alone insufficient
